test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two taps P and Q can fill a tank alone in 10 hours and 12 hours respectively. If the two taps are opened at 9 a.m., then at what time should the tap P be closed to completely fill the tank at exactly 3 p.m.?
solution:
Given:

Two taps P and Q can fill a tank alone in 10 hours and 12 hours respectively

Calculation:

Let the capacity of the tank = 60 litres (LCM of 10 and 12)

The efficiency of pipe P = 60/10

= 6 litres/hour

The efficiency of pipe Q = 60/12 

= 5 litres/hour

According to the question,

Total time in which tank has filled = 6 hours (3 p.m - 9 a.m)

Let the pipe P was closed at after n hours

According to the question

⇒ 6 × (n) + 5 × 6 = 60

⇒ 6n + 30 = 60

⇒ 6n = 30

⇒ n = 5

**So, 5 hours after 9:00 am. which means 2:00 pm, **the tap P should be closed at 3: 00 pm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab777b338e076ebcb2cdb89e2ff2843a1499dfb3df00b235186d1c5e1857e625.png] __Confusion Points__

Not asking about after how many hours the tap should be stopped. It is asking about the time (in p.m.) when the tap will be stopped. [Which is mentioned in the question]

Start at 9 a.m + 5 hours = 2 p.m
